title: Low key kind of loved this creative choice! #TheLostBoys #Broadway #B...
transcript: The Lost Boys on Broadway did something that I have never seen a musical do before. And that is it has a post credit scene. What do I mean by this? So the show ends, they come out, they do their bows as normal, and then there's a blackout and then they start another scene. And the audience was pretty confused, if I'm being honest. We're all like standing because we were applauding for the show. And so it was like, do we sit down? Like, what is protocol for this? This is uncharted territory. And there was also this question of like, can we record this? Cause it's technically after bows, and generally anything after bows is like fair game to film. But this wasn't like a curtain call encore. Like, this was a proper scene. So like, I would strongly recommend not filming it. But it is very fun and I hope they keep it. Cause the show is still in early previews. Obviously I'm not gonna spoil exactly what that moment is. You have to see the show to find out. I will say it is not a moment from the movie. So whether you are familiar with the source material or not, I think it'll be a fun surprise for everyone. And I think that as people learn that this is a thing that is happening, the audience reaction to it will be a little bit less awkward.
classificationReason: Creator clearly saw The Lost Boys on Broadway and describes specific experience including the post-credit scene and audience reaction.
